Each case is its own ABBA+BAAB. Overall results are medians of four run p50s/p99s/rates per side; each block uses two runs per side. No original observations are pooled and no positive latency or negative rate change is filtered.
Wire FNV is an actual preflight oracle checksum; each output is fully validated. The iteration accumulator depends on actual N and is retained, not required to be equal across runs.

Numeric probe JSON does not record per-run hardware metadata. Compiler/target, common harness and actual frozen binary identities are checked; endpoint environment records do not substitute for continuous frequency/temperature telemetry.
